title: Everyone Here HUMS a Note of Their Own
description:
In this town, everyone hums one note all day long, and a little ring over every head ripples with it. Mine has never made a sound.

This winter my stepdad's note started to fade. And every evening I walked past his barbershop, a customer in a striped cape was sitting one chair nearer to the chair he kept for me.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Whose note would yours sit on top of?
